item.name: Ticketing flow (Used by the default user)

request.description:
For filtration pass ?filters array like ?filters\[category\] and $filters\[from\] and so on.

Those are the currently available filteration options

- category for filtering by category id
    
- date for filtering by the exact start date
    
- from for filtering by a minimum starting date
    
- to for filtering by an upper limit date
    
- city for filtering by the city id
    
- price for filtering by a minimum price
    
- rating for filtering by a minimum rate
    
- free for getting free events
    
- latitude and longitude for filtering by the location, should be provided together (gives you the nearest events to the location info you provided)

request.description:
For filtration pass ?filters array like ?filters\[when\] and $filters\[in\] and so on

Those are the currently available filteration options

- when can be week to get talents participating this week, month to get talents participating this month, and next to get talent participating after this month
- in should be a city id to get talents participating at a given city
- rating to filter by a minimum rating
- myicket = true to filter by myticket discoveries
- category is the category id
Seat status can be available, held, reserved (order created), and sold (order paid)
holds will be automatically released after 10 minutes if not become reserved

For filtration pass ?filters array like ?filters\[category\] and $filters\[in\] and so on

Those are the currently available filteration options

- category is the id of a service category
    
- in is a city id
    
- rating to filter by a minimum rating

For filtration pass ?filters array like ?filters\[in\] and so on

Those are the currently available filteration options

- in is a city id
After successfully claiming a gifted ticket you will find the order alongside the qr payload with the gift details as well as with your orders.

For filtration pass ?filters array like ?filters\[where\] and $filters\[date\] and so on

Those are the currently available filteration options

- where to filter by the city id that hosts the experience
    
- category to filter by the category id of the experience
    
- type which can either be attraction or activity
    
- latitude and longitude for filtering by the location, should be provided together (gives you the nearest experiences to the location info you provided)
